systems.owner: Ministry of Civil Service and the Steering Committee for Public Finance Reform (COREF), with World Bank financing of USD 250 million
systems.tiers: national: more than 118,000 biometric cards issued to civil servants in all 26 provinces by July 2025, handed over by field teams

systems.platform: national digital ID, built by Trident (Singapore)

note: A central civil-service registry whose cards were distributed in every province by travelling teams; no local government office, system used there or connection is described.
